positive_cases.case: three stones on a 7 mm row
positive_cases.expect: one closed trench of 5 stations, positive volume, gem_ids in row order
document entity count unchanged until Enter; Undo restores it
one Channel Builder body with om9.cutter kind=channel_cutter and row=[Gem 0, Gem 1, Gem 2]

negative_cases.case: a channel narrower than its stone
a trench deeper than the stone allows

limitations: The channel is a swept 4-corner prism (one station per stone plus two end caps), not a B-Rep solid.
A channel narrower than its widest stone is refused instead of clipped: the stones sit in the channel it cuts.
The end profiles shape the two end caps only; the middle section (Middle=Wide|Deep) is a third profile.
